title: ECD Connect Data Report
text:
Data report as of 31 October 2025


South Africa’s ECD sector is moving towards a more integrated data system, with efforts underway to strengthen the DBE’s EMIS and align partner data contributions.
ECD Connect plays a key role in this ecosystem - not only supporting practitioners and CHWs on the ground, but also generating rich data about early learning and health service delivery.
This report provides an initial snapshot of some of the data emerging from ECD Connect and explores how, as the datasets grow, they could contribute to broader insight and learning across the sector.







ECD Connect has grown rapidly across both education and health since launch. The figures below show our overall footprint to date, reflecting adoption across the open-access app, partner versions, and Grow Great’s CHW Connect.
The totals represent cumulative numbers since each platform’s laun

Together, these numbers represent the growing network of practitioners, CHWs, and children engaging with the platform.





ECD Connect operates through several tailored versions, each designed for specific user groups. The sections below summarise usage and engagement across education and health.




An open-access version of the app - open to any principal/practitioner working in ECD in South Africa. Since launch in April 2025 to October 2025



1,605


unique sign-ups




537


preschools added




1,637


children registered






17% of users who joined the app over 30 days ago have logged in again after 30 days. This is higher than the standard global app retention rate of 7% by day 30.
8% of practitioners who signed up over 30 days ago have logged in within the past month.





A customisable version for organisations who want to use a organisation-branded version of the app within their networks. We currently have versions for: Khululeka, Ntataise, and True North. Since pilot launch in October 2024 to October 2025



226


unique sign-ups




61


preschools added




1,020


children registered






26% of users who joined the app over 30 days ago have logged in again after 30 days.
12% of practitioners who signed up over 30 days ago have logged in within the past month.








Since launch in April 2024 to October 2025



342


CHWs registered




60 202


child visits completed




6 501


pregnant client visits completed






79% of CHWs who joined the app over 30 days ago have logged in again after 30 days.
35% of CHWs who signed up over 30 days ago have logged in within the past month.










As use of the education app expands, richer patterns are emerging in the data being captured — from child demographics and attendance to preschool business trends. The visuals below provide early insight into how the platform reflects real-world programme participation and operations.
























































As we roll out to more users, we are seeing an increase in the number of attendance registers saved per month.
